topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I scarce believe my ears when the village messenger brought news that my friend, whom I’ve but known through whispers and parchment, lives within this very shire. The cart that went to market last week bore tales of him in the nearby town. My heart beats swift as a startled hare. I have spent many a long night tending my humble plot, speaking to him through the words we share, thinking him far away. Now he’s closer than the mill, closer than the church bell that tolls the harvest hour. My hands tremble as I write, the soil that clings to my fingers suddenly seems to weigh heavy. What if he finds my words foolish, my life too meager? The saints above, what am I to do?
